title: Posts
noPostsDescription: The board is where an initiative says things out loud — a change of plan, a date, a welcome. Posts are read newest first, and the ones that matter can be pinned to the top.
name: Headline
dangerZoneDescription: Destructive actions. Deleted posts go to the trash and can be restored before the retention period ends.

pin.pinnedBanner: Pinned to the top of this board
pin.expiresHelp: Optional. The post drops back into the feed by its own date when this passes.
pin.managerOnly: Only initiative managers can pin a post.

schedule.label: Schedule
schedule.hint: Leave this empty to post now. Set a time and the notice stays a draft — nobody sees it and nobody is told until then.

read.whoReadHint: Everyone this notice was shared with.
read.everyone: Everyone it went to has read it.

notFoundDescription: The post you're looking for does not exist or has been removed.
noAccessDescription: You do not have permission to view this post.

unsaved.title: Leave without saving?
unsaved.body: This post has changes that have not been saved. Leaving now loses them.

poll.heading: Poll
poll.question: Question
poll.questionHint: Optional — leave it empty and the headline is the question.
poll.choicesLocked: The choices are fixed now that people have answered. Everything else can still change.
poll.allowsMultipleHint: Let people choose more than one answer.
poll.hideResultsHint: The numbers stay hidden until someone answers, so early answers don't sway later ones.
poll.isAnonymousHint: Show the totals but not who chose what.
poll.anonymityLocked: People answered anonymously, so this can't be switched off.
poll.closesAtHint: Optional — after this, no one can answer or change their answer.
poll.pickSeveral: Pick as many as you like
poll.whoVotedHint: Who chose what, and who hasn't answered yet.
